channel.description: Latest articles from Submarine Telecoms Forum (subtelforum.com)

item.title: Technology-Driven Cable Market Cycles
item.description: José Chesnoy examines technology-driven cycles in the submarine cable industry in this article from SubTel Forum Issue 146.

item.title: What Is It With This Direct United States Telegraph Cable?
item.description: Derek Cassidy explores the Direct United States Telegraph Cable in this article from SubTel Forum Issue 146.

item.title: SubTel Forum Magazine #147 – Finance &amp; Legal – OUT NOW!
item.description: Issue 147 of SubTel Forum explores industry limits, FCC cable licensing reforms, Arctic broadband, AI cable strategy, and subsea risk.

item.title: Marshall Islands Advances Pacific Connect Cable Project
item.description: Marshall Islands joins Pacific Connect to deploy Iokwe subsea cable, boosting resilience, speed, and global digital access.

item.title: Amazon Says Drone Activity Disrupts AWS Bahrain Region
item.description: Drone activity disrupts AWS Bahrain region, forcing workload shifts and exposing risks to cloud infrastructure in conflict zones.

item.title: Tonga Gains New Transpacific Cable Link via Hawaiki
item.description: Tonga lands Hawaiki subsea cable, boosting resilience, bandwidth, and direct transpacific connectivity for digital growth.

item.title: Strengthening Subsea Cable Security in the Indo-Pacific
item.description: CSIS outlines frameworks to boost Indo-Pacific subsea cable security through cooperation, regulation, and resilience strategies.

item.title: Meta, Lightstorm Boost Bifrost Cable Capacity with Ciena
item.description: Meta and Lightstorm enhance the Bifrost subsea cable with Ciena technology, increasing capacity to support AI and cloud traffic.

item.title: InfiniVAN Secures Poro Point Cable Landing Station Lease
item.description: InfiniVAN secures long-term lease for Poro Point cable station, enabling open access for subsea cables and boosting Philippine connectivity.

item.title: Colt Secures Capacity on Juno Subsea Cable
item.description: Colt secures capacity on the JUNO subsea cable system, expanding trans-Pacific connectivity between Japan and the United States.

item.title: Iran War Sparks Subsea Cable Disruption Fears
item.description: India assesses risks to subsea cables amid Iran war, with the government preparing contingency plans to prevent internet disruptions.

item.title: UK Tightens National Security Rules for Telecom Infrastructure
item.description: UK refines NSIA rules, increasing scrutiny on telecom and data infrastructure investments, including subsea cable systems.

item.title: Portugal Positions Itself as a Strategic Hub for Data Center
item.description: Portugal strengthens its role as a global data hub, leveraging subsea cable connectivity, renewable energy, and strategic positioning.

item.title: Red Sea Cable Fears Raise India Internet Risk
item.description: Rising Red Sea cable threats amid US-Iran tensions could disrupt India’s internet, exposing critical infrastructure vulnerabilities.

item.title: Chinese Captain Sentenced for Taiwan Cable Damage
item.description: Chinese captain jailed over Taiwan cable sabotage highlights rising risks to global undersea infrastructure and geopolitical tensions.
